_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4326 — the `exo__Instance_class` guard route named only the REPLACING Convert pair, so dual-typing an asset (adding exo__Deprecated{Asset,Class,Property} beside the existing class) had no named path and authors went around the product with a raw Edit-append. The additive command `append-instance-class` (grounding ac0cf4ce, property_append) was minted 2026-08-28, after the 2026-08-19 sweep that built the table. M1 = the path absent again; M2 = named but its required --input unstated (a name without its payload is not a path); M3 = control, the replacing pair swapped out instead of kept. red_re anchors on the `● <suite> › A<n> …` header.
